name: ai.privos.demo-hr-management-ws
title: HR Mini app V3
description: PrivOS Room-scoped HR management application for recruitment, CV processing, employee lifecycle, payroll, email history, and document drafting.

permissions.reason: Room context consumers: src/ui/App.tsx, src/ui/bot-drafting-tab.tsx, src/ui/company-home.tsx, src/ui/contact-collector-form.tsx, src/ui/cv-scored/CVScoredTab.tsx, src/ui/email-history/EmailTab.tsx, src/ui/jd-chatbot-functional.tsx, src/ui/lifecycle/components/CreateDetailedProfileForm.tsx, src/ui/lifecycle/components/EmailComposerModal.tsx, src/ui/lifecycle/components/ProfileCard.tsx, src/ui/lifecycle/components/ProfileListView.tsx, src/ui/lifecycle/LifecycleDashboard.tsx, src/ui/pipeline-dashboard.tsx, src/ui/recruitment-panel.tsx, src/ui/theme-provider.tsx, and src/ui/training-dashboard.tsx use the verified Room context; src/ui/payroll/access/usePayrollAccessPolling.ts reads privos.context.get.

Room List reads are consumed by src/services/EmailHistoryRepository.ts, src/ui/contact-collector-form.tsx, src/ui/cv-scored/CVScoredTab.tsx, src/ui/email-history/email-history-service.ts, src/ui/lifecycle/services/lifecycleService.ts, src/ui/lifecycle/services/PrivOSLifecycleService.ts, src/ui/list-items-table.tsx, and src/ui/pipeline-service.ts.
Room List query/search consumers are src/ui/cv-scored/CVScoredTab.tsx, src/ui/lifecycle/services/PrivOSLifecycleService.ts, and src/ui/pipeline-service.ts.
permissions.degradedBehavior: List screens use the bounded non-query route and display that results may be capped.

permissions.reason: Room List create, field, item, stage-move, update, and delete consumers are src/services/EmailHistoryRepository.ts, src/ui/contact-collector-form.tsx, src/ui/cv-scored/CVScoredTab.tsx, src/ui/email-history/email-history-service.ts, src/ui/lifecycle/services/lifecycleService.ts, src/ui/lifecycle/services/PrivOSLifecycleService.ts, src/ui/list-items-table.tsx, and src/ui/pipeline-service.ts.
permissions.degradedBehavior: Recruitment, CV, lifecycle, and email-history writes are disabled; reads remain available.

permissions.reason: Room file/folder discovery, content, search, and preview consumers are src/ui/drafting/services/CompanyContextProvider.ts, src/ui/email-templates/interview-email-template-repository.ts, src/ui/pipeline-dashboard.tsx, src/ui/pipeline-service.ts, src/ui/privos-rest.ts, src/ui/recruitment-panel.tsx, and src/ui/training-dashboard.tsx.
permissions.degradedBehavior: Existing document previews and Room file discovery are unavailable.

permissions.reason: Room file/folder create, update, delete, and upload consumers are src/services/PrivosApi.ts, src/ui/bot-drafting-tab.tsx, src/ui/company-home.tsx, src/ui/contact-collector-form.tsx, src/ui/email-templates/interview-email-template-repository.ts, src/ui/jd-chatbot-functional.tsx, src/ui/lifecycle/components/CreateDetailedProfileForm.tsx, src/ui/onboarding/PrivosApi.ts, src/ui/onboarding/services/OnboardingService.ts, src/ui/payroll/services/PayrollExportService.ts, src/ui/pipeline-dashboard.tsx, src/ui/pipeline-service.ts, src/ui/privos-rest.ts, src/ui/recruitment-panel.tsx, and src/ui/training-dashboard.tsx.
permissions.degradedBehavior: Upload, generated-document persistence, and payroll export upload are disabled.

permissions.reason: src/ui/pipeline-service.ts invokes the CV evaluator skill and src/ui/pipeline-dashboard.tsx invokes the JD generator skill from Room Files.
permissions.degradedBehavior: Skill-backed drafting and screening controls are hidden.

permissions.reason: Room AI workflow consumers src/ui/bot-drafting-tab.tsx, src/ui/company-home.tsx, src/ui/jd-chatbot-functional.tsx, src/ui/pipeline-dashboard.tsx, and src/ui/pipeline-service.ts depend on the sandbox bot-key connection.
permissions.degradedBehavior: Sandbox bot-key connection actions are unavailable.

permissions.reason: Room AI workflow consumers src/ui/bot-drafting-tab.tsx, src/ui/company-home.tsx, src/ui/jd-chatbot-functional.tsx, src/ui/pipeline-dashboard.tsx, and src/ui/pipeline-service.ts depend on waking the Room sandbox before generation.

AI generation consumers src/ui/bot-drafting-tab.tsx, src/ui/company-home.tsx, src/ui/jd-chatbot-functional.tsx, src/ui/pipeline-dashboard.tsx, and src/ui/pipeline-service.ts start and poll Room generation work.
permissions.degradedBehavior: AI generation and polling actions are disabled.

permissions.reason: AI chat consumers src/ui/bot-drafting-tab.tsx, src/ui/company-home.tsx, src/ui/jd-chatbot-functional.tsx, src/ui/pipeline-dashboard.tsx, and src/ui/pipeline-service.ts read Room generation/session results; the direct ai-messages.list calls are in src/ui/company-home.tsx and src/ui/pipeline-service.ts.
permissions.degradedBehavior: Existing AI chat/session history is unavailable.

permissions.reason: AI chat write consumers src/ui/bot-drafting-tab.tsx, src/ui/company-home.tsx, src/ui/jd-chatbot-functional.tsx, src/ui/pipeline-dashboard.tsx, and src/ui/pipeline-service.ts create Room messages and generation work; direct ai-messages.send/startGeneration calls are in src/ui/company-home.tsx and src/ui/pipeline-service.ts.
permissions.degradedBehavior: New AI chat/generation actions are disabled.

permissions.reason: src/ui/payroll/services/PayrollService.ts and src/ui/payroll/components/PayrollDashboard.tsx call hrm.payroll.query for payroll_records, and src/mcp-message-handlers.ts currently forwards it to PrivOS DB. Backend owner authorization is additional to this PrivOS grant.

src/ui/payroll/services/PayrollService.ts calls hrm.payroll.create, hrm.payroll.update, and hrm.payroll.delete for payroll_records, and src/mcp-message-handlers.ts currently forwards them to PrivOS DB. Backend owner authorization is additional to this PrivOS grant.

No current schema-read call exists; this grant is reserved for Task 8 src/payroll/PayrollRepository.ts to verify payroll_records through the backend repository boundary. Backend owner authorization is additional to this PrivOS grant.

src/ui/payroll/services/PayrollService.ts currently calls privos.db.registerCollection for payroll_records; Task 8 moves registration to src/payroll/PayrollRepository.ts. Backend owner authorization is additional to this PrivOS grant.

dataPolicy.retention: HR records, including tracked email content and delivery metadata, remain in the PrivOS Room until an authorized user deletes them; the stateless app container keeps no local persistent copy.
